title: 2027 Race Takes Shape: Tinubu Projected to Lead 20 States as IPOB Issues Election Boycott Threat
detail: A state-by-state forecast published September 2 by a Nigerian political intelligence group projects President Tinubu's APC winning 20 states (including the full South-West bloc and Kano) if the 2027 election were held today, against 9 for Atiku Abubakar's ADC (concentrated in the North) and 8 plus the FCT for Peter Obi's NDC — while cautioning "a lot can happen between now and" the January 16, 2027 vote. The same day, coverage of the broader political landscape noted Nyesom Wike, FCT Minister, publicly defending Tinubu's right to campaign amid the ongoing US drug-case scrutiny; Atiku pledging to reform the Nigerian Education Loan Fund; Peter Obi continuing opposition coalition talks after his May 30 adoption as NDC candidate; and the Indigenous People of Biafra (IPOB) issuing a 14-day ultimatum over detained leader Nnamdi Kanu's appeal, threatening to boycott elections in the South-East if unmet.

media.caption: Nigeria's 2027 election campaign intensifies amid legal battles and party realignments
